verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a physical laptop processor (an 18-core Oryon CPU with a Hexagon NPU, shipping in Windows-on-Arm PCs), not a hosted software service. Asking whether the core product can be self-hosted is a category error for this kind of product. Evidence about running AI models on-device via AI Hub and GenieX concerns local model deployment, not self-hosting the product itself, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
